notes.title: Time Breaking: Dino Breach is now on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey R.O.P.E. Soldiers,[/h2]

The moment has arrived: the Kickstarter campaign for Time Breaking: Dino Breach is officially LIVE! 🎉🔥

We’ve been working hard to bring this project to life, and now we need your help to make it a reality! With your support, we can expand the game, add more content, and deliver the ultimate survival horror experience… with dinosaurs! 🦕💥

🎯 Check out the campaign and support us here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/digitalyarts/time-breaking-dino-breach/description]Time Breaking on Kickstarter[/url]

[h3]💎  What’s waiting for you on Kickstarter? 💎[/h3]

[list]
[*]Exclusive rewards for backers! 🏆
[*]New insights into the game and stretch goals! 📖
[*]A chance to become part of Time Breaking: Dino Breach!
[/list]

Every pledge, big or small, makes a huge difference. And if you can’t donate, sharing the campaign with friends and fellow survival horror fans is a massive help! 💙

We have also opened a Discord community where we can discuss and party 🎉
What's more, Early Bird backers will receive a special role at the end of the campaign!

Log into the community: [url=https://discord.gg/VjxnemjKvF]Discord[/url]

Thank you for being part of our community. Let’s continue this adventure through time together! 🚀
